publicSourceDiscovery.priorityReason: Texas growth market; strong candidate after DCAD/Tarrant/Bexar/Harris.
sourceSearchQueries: Travis Central Appraisal District parcel data
sourceRules: Use official county, assessor/appraiser, GIS, municipal, state, or federal sources first.
Do not activate this county until exact parcel counts and join keys are verified.
Do not infer owner phone/email from permits, contractors, applicants, or scraped pages.
problemSolvingLoop: Discover official sources and preserve source dataset identifiers.
Audit schema, exact counts, geometry validity, nulls, and duplicate candidate keys.
Select a complete duplicate-safe feature identity and document secondary business identifiers.
Build a bounded-memory sample before attempting the full county snapshot.
Publish viewport chunks and search shards, then reconcile source, emitted, skipped, and joined counts.
Run county QC and keep visible activation disabled until every individual gate passes.

joinKeys.appraisal: direct same-feature TCAD attributes, keyed by snapshot OBJECTID and business PROP_ID
joinKeys.land: direct same-feature TCAD acres, land use, improvement year, and value fields
joinKeys.secondaryParcelGisId: geo_id (373,552 populated; 13,130 missing; 88 duplicate excess occurrences)
joinKeys.dimensions: direct Shape.STArea() / Shape.STLength() plus TCAD and GIS acre fields
joinKeys.permits: City of Austin permit location -> exact normalized parcel address; duplicate addresses require uniquely nearest official permit point; 187,712 records joined and 100,691 preserved unmatched/ambiguous
joinKeys.zoning: parcel centroid -> official City of Austin zoning polygon -> PROP_ID/accountNum; 207,300 parcel classifications within municipal source coverage
joinKeys.floodplain: parcel centroid -> official Austin fully-developed and FEMA floodplain polygons -> PROP_ID/accountNum; federal SFHA remains distinct from the local regulatory 100-year floodplain
joinKeys.developmentSignals: parcel-joined City of Austin permits -> evidence-only permit, demolition, construction, alteration, and occupancy classifications for 92,862 parcels
joinKeys.migrationDemand: source-needed: aggregate geography join, not individual people

productionGap: Austin now has 13/14 intelligence groups: full parcel geometry, certified appraisal enrichment, viewport/search delivery, dimensions, block/subdivision context, zoning, floodplain, permits/CO, and development signals. Migration demand, PMTiles, source-freshness certification, and visible pilot authorization remain gated.
pilotNotes: Austin zoning, floodplain, permits, and development sources cover their published City service extents, not every Travis County municipality. Keep blank-safe coverage outside source footprints, preserve unmatched permits, keep federal SFHA distinct from Austin's local fully-developed floodplain, and never treat issued permits as proof of construction or completion.
